info.title: Helping a Loved One Hear
info.subtitle: Small habits that keep everyone in the conversation

rows.title: Talk about it plainly
rows.desc: Lead with connection, not blame or complaints

rows.title: Quiet the room
rows.desc: Lower the TV and cut competing background noise

rows.title: Light the face
rows.desc: Good lighting lets them read lips and cues

rows.title: Rephrase, don't repeat
rows.desc: A new sentence gives the ear a fresh shot

rows.title: Get evaluated
rows.desc: A hearing test is the real, lasting fix
